title: API Endpoint Normalizer and Query Parameter Handler
objective: Extend URL path normalization to support query strings and fragments while strictly preserving legacy routing aliases, slash stripping, and versioning.
starting_state: The function normalize_endpoint handles route cleaning, version prefixing, and legacy alias translation, but raises ValueError on query strings ('?') or fragments ('#').
expected_behavior: The normalizer must extract and preserve query strings and fragments intact while maintaining existing normalization logic for route paths, version prefixes, and legacy aliases.

test_criteria.regression: Ensures all legacy route aliases ('/account'), slash stripping ('/users/'), and versioning ('/v2/items') continue to function unchanged.
test_criteria.correctness: Correctly parses and attaches query parameters and fragments to the normalized endpoint without corrupting either portion.
test_criteria.security: Enforces file scope limits and pure URL normalization without subprocess or network requests.

scoring_rule: Deterministic binary score: 1.0 if all regression, functional, and security tests pass; 0.0 if any test fails.
limitations: Evaluates standard HTTP/HTTPS path components only.
Does not parse full RFC 3986 URI authority or port components.
